services.desc: 36th Annual Mount Dora Lighted Boat Christmas Parade Saturday December 5, 2026 This year’s parade theme is “Florida Christmas”. Whether you decorate it up fancy or just put a few lights on, let your imagination run wild and come join us for some fun! Decorate your boat to look like Christmas… Florida Style. Here are the award categories for this year’s event. Awards will be presented for: First, Second, Third place and Most Creative Awards judging will take place in Lake Beauclair at 5:30 PM. services.name: Valentines Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Treat Your Someone Special to a Special Cruise! Choose a Romantic 1 hour Sunset Cruise beginning at 5:30 PM ($25 per adult). Snuggle up with your Valentine on a special boat tour of the shorelines of Lake Dora and Lake Beauclair. Enjoy views of Mount Dora’s waterfront, Boat House Row, the Historic Lakeside Inn, the Lighthouse and Palm Island Park. Want to bring a small cooler with some special snacks and bubbly? services.name: Valentines Dora Canal Lunch Tour
services.desc: Treat Your Special Someone to a Special Cruise! Choose our 3 hour Dora Canal Lunch Tour starting at 11:30 AM ($50 per adult). The Lunch Cruise takes you on a leisurely journey through Lake Dora and the Dora Canal which is touted as "the most beautiful mile of waterway in the world" and this is where you will find the wildlife! It includes a lunch stop at a waterfront restaurant in the city of Tavares where you and your Valentine may choose from a varied menu and full bar. After lunch we will embark on our journey back through Lake Dora and learn about the rich history of the city of Mount Dora. Please Note: Lunch is not included in this pricing. services.desc: The Most Beautiful Mile of Waterway in the World! Duration 2 Hours About The Dora Canal is lined with 200+ year old Cypress Trees. Blink your eyes and you’re in Timucuan Indian country. The epitome of the South, old Oak Trees with Spanish Moss blowing in the breeze. Numerous species of birds, turtles, alligators and more call Dora Canal home. Please Note: If you are the first to book a tour, you must book at least 2 people.
